admission.justification: Spans cache installation, repository scanning, CLI/init/install pre-warm hooks, and read-vs-write error handling across seven modules, guarded by four dedicated tests, and completes FAM-CSVQBJ's runtime provisioning contract.

applicability: External grammar cache installation, repository language scanning/warming, and grammar-load failure handling across language_cache.py, language_scanner.py, cli/languages.py, memory_initialization.py, runtime/install.py, read_anchors.py, and code_anchors.py.
conditions: Pinned wheels and tree-sitter-language-pack wheels download lazily into isolated AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE targets after SHA-256 verification and atomic zip extraction without mutating the MCP venv.
Warm cached receipts reuse installed grammars with zero network traffic and enforce tree-sitter ABI 13-15 compatibility.
Unresolved or failing grammar loads degrade reads to unsupported_locator while refusing symbol anchor writes with actionable AnchorResolutionError naming the GrammarUnavailableError cause.
Repository auto-scanning leaves ambiguous suffixes (.h, .m, .v) unbound by default and keeps .lean permanently reserved for the built-in Lean scanner.
exclusions: User-supplied local custom shared libraries bypass PyPI wheel downloads and are loaded directly from local filesystem paths under KNO-R11@v1 §3.
statement: Repository language auto-scanning and lazy hash-verified wheel installation populate the isolated AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE directory without mutating the frozen virtual environment, reuse warm cached grammars with zero network traffic, preserve read-degrade versus write-refuse error asymmetry on load failures, default ambiguous suffixes to occurrence matching, and keep .lean permanently reserved for the built-in Lean scanner.
title: Lazy hash-verified AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE install with read/write asymmetry
